title: Operationalizing Governed Agentic Workflows in Regulated Finance: A Customer Zero Case Study using Zafin AIOS
abstract: arXiv:2610.33253v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Regulated industries such as finance and healthcare face critical governance challenges that hamper the adoption of AI-assisted software development and hinder the transition from experimental pilots to production work. This paper presents Zafin AIOS, an end-to-end orchestration platform and control plane designed to deploy AI within regulated industries such as finance. We provide the architectural principles and an empirical comparison between AI-assisted and human-led workloads. To validate this framework empirically, we conduct a case study analysis of Zafin's internal enterprise workflows, which we refer to as Customer Zero. This paper contributes a production case study of AI-assisted software engineering in regulated industries. We evaluate the results of using Zafin AIOS with two different production codebases, one for the pricing execution platform and the other for the client deal negotiation platform. translated_abstract: 金融和医疗等受监管行业面临着关键的治理挑战，这些挑战阻碍了AI辅助软件开发的采用，也阻碍了从实验性试点向生产环境工作的过渡。本文介绍了Zafin AIOS，一个专为在金融等受监管行业中部署AI而设计的端到端编排平台和控制平面。我们提供了架构原则，以及AI辅助工作负载与人工主导工作负载之间的实证比较。为了对该框架进行实证验证，我们对Zafin的内部企业工作流程进行了案例研究分析，我们将其称为“零号客户”。本文为受监管行业中的AI辅助软件工程贡献了一个生产案例研究。我们在两个不同的生产代码库上评估了使用Zafin AIOS的结果，一个用于定价执行平台，另一个用于客户交易谈判平台。我们的贡献是一个……
tldr: 本文提出Zafin AIOS这一端到端编排与控制平台，并通过“零号客户”内部生产案例研究，验证了治理型智能体工作流在受监管金融行业中从试点走向生产落地的可行性与有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Zafin AIOS, an end-to-end orchestration and control plane, and validates through a "Customer Zero" production case study that governed agentic workflows can be operationalized in regulated finance, moving from pilots to production software engineering.
